rationale: With only 30 minutes remaining until the mandatory liquidation at the close, the risk of holding through the final session volatility outweighs the modest unrealized gain. The price action has stalled below the 9-EMA and is consolidating near the session VWAP, indicating a lack of momentum to push toward the $33.50 take-profit before the bell. Securing the positive P&L avoids the uncertainty of the closing auction.
